description:
Drum and bass champions Serum, Bladerunner, and Voltage, aka Kings Of The Rollers are back in the ring with their latest slammers ‘Overload’ (feat. Sweetie Irie) and ‘Somebody Else Part 2’ (feat. Lydia Plain). 

In 2020, they released ‘The Main Event EP’, a 4-track smasher packed with heavy basslines, ethereal synths, and creeping melodies. Cooking up certified bangers such as ‘XXX’, the Circuits Rewire of ‘Burnt Ends’, cold-cut classic ‘Somebody Else’ feat. Lydia Plain and ‘Solar Heat’, Kings Of The Rollers are coming back stronger than ever with two more dancefloor destroyers to add to their back catalogue. 

Punchy drums, zestful chimes, and a solid booming bassline set the tone for ‘Overload’. As reggae dancehall legend Sweetie Irie flows over the innovative blend of production styles from The Kings, granting us an irresistibly vibey roller that will definitely get raves rumbling. 

Combining efforts with Lydia Plain who is no stranger to Kings Of The Rollers’ productions with previous collaborations including ‘The Sky Is Falling’ and drum & bass hit ‘Somebody Else’, Lydia’s enchanting vocals compliment the eerie atmospheres and trademark synthwork making ‘Somebody Else Part 2’ another future classic singalong anthem set to have ravers singing their hearts out like its predecessor. 

Catch Kings Of The Rollers alongside Inja, tearing up the UK with their freshly announced Royal Rumble tour coming to a city near you soon, as well as knocking out a sold-out Printworks show and an all-day special at Studio 338.

Get your cricket bats at the ready and buckle up for the ride of a lifetime. After the successes of their Royal Rumble stage at Hospitality Weekend In The Woods, the levels have been upped yet again!
